title: 用 AI 做演示文稿，打开创意思路
description: 中文优先的 Agent Skills：制作可编辑 PPTX、探索产品创意。查看原创案例、安装步骤与能力边界。
body:
subaru-slides 把主题与资料整理成演示文稿；subaru-brainstorm 帮你展开不同方向，并将想法变成候选方案或实验。

先检查案例，再把同样的方法用到自己的材料上。

npx skills add qqc0821/subaru-skills --skill subaru-brainstorm

先试无需第三方运行依赖的 brainstorm。slides 的第三方再分发授权尚待确认，请先查看许可与发布状态。

开始使用查看三个完整案例

从你的问题开始

  • 怎样把资料做成可编辑中文 PPT？
  • 没有图片生成工具，还能做演示文稿吗？
  • AI 点子总是相似，怎样换一个思考入口？
  • 怎样保存一次讨论，下次从原来的分支继续？

先完成一次小任务

安装后用 5 条已知事实做 6 页汇报，或提出一个你还没想清楚的问题。检查 Agent 是否读到了 skill，再检查结果是否保留你的限制。

本页不承诺任意宿主、任意工具组合都已验证。查看本次实际运行环境。

title: Build presentations. Develop ideas.
description: Chinese-first agent skills for editable PPTX and brainstorming. Inspect original cases, install a skill and understand its limits.
body:
subaru-slides turns topics and materials into presentations. subaru-brainstorm explores distinct directions and develops proposals or experiments.

Inspect the examples, then try the method with your own material.

npx skills add qqc0821/subaru-skills --skill subaru-brainstorm

Start with brainstorm, which needs no third-party runtime. Third-party redistribution permission for slides remains unresolved; read the license and release status.

Get startedInspect three worked examples

Start with your question

  • How do I turn material into an editable Chinese PPT?
  • Can I make presentations without image generation?
  • How can I move beyond repetitive AI ideas?
  • How do I save a discussion and resume the same branch?

Complete one small task

Try a six-slide presentation from five known facts, or bring one unresolved question. Check that the agent has loaded the skill and retained your constraints.

We do not claim all hosts or tool combinations have been tested. See the actual authoring environment.

title: 怎样安装并完成第一次使用？
description: subaru-skills 安装命令、自然语言调用、实际验证环境、更新方式与安装问题排查。
body:
选择一个 skill，安装后让宿主加载它；不必一次安装整个仓库。

安装 brainstorm

npx skills add qqc0821/subaru-skills --skill subaru-brainstorm
用 $subaru-brainstorm 探索团队知识库还能有哪些用途。先给 8 个不同机制的方向，暂时不要排名。

使用 slides 前

先检查第三方来源的许可状态。需要 Node.js / npm 才能运行 skills CLI；没有 CLI 时，可把对应 skill 文件夹放进宿主支持的 skill 目录。具体加载方式以宿主文档为准。

npx skills add qqc0821/subaru-skills --skill subaru-slides
用 $subaru-slides 把我的资料做成 6 页中文汇报。Full Auto，优先可编辑 PPTX，保留数据来源；缺工具时说明替代方案。

本次实际运行环境

范围已验证未验证
案例编写本次 Codex 会话直接读取本地 skill 指引并产出文件其他宿主的加载、自动选中与调用
原生 PPTXpython-pptx 构建与复读；LibreOffice 渲染PowerPoint、Keynote、Google Slides 实机与跨机字体
CLI文档提供安装命令本任务未做临时宿主中的端到端安装更新

Agent 没有使用 skill 时

  1. 检查宿主是否识别安装目录。
  2. 按宿主要求重新加载或开启新会话。
  3. 显式调用 $subaru-slides 或 $subaru-brainstorm；不支持该语法时，要求 Agent 使用对应 skill。
  4. 检查名称与文件内容是否正确，反馈时附宿主、命令与错误信息，不附密钥。

更新与版本

npx skills update subaru-brainstorm -p

在原项目目录更新；全局安装使用 -g。更新前备份自定义内容。版本读取各包 SKILL.md 的 metadata.version；默认安装跟随 main，不等于稳定版。完整更新与固定 tag 说明。

title: Install a skill and complete a first task
description: Install commands, sample prompts, actual authoring environment, updates and first-use troubleshooting.
body:
Select one skill, install it, then have your host load it. You do not need the whole repository.

Install brainstorm

npx skills add qqc0821/subaru-skills --skill subaru-brainstorm
Use $subaru-brainstorm to explore new uses for a team knowledge library. Give eight directions with different mechanisms; do not rank them yet.

Before using slides

Read the third-party license status. The skills CLI needs Node.js / npm. Without it, place the desired skill folder in a directory your host supports; consult that host's loading instructions.

npx skills add qqc0821/subaru-skills --skill subaru-slides
Use $subaru-slides to turn my material into six Chinese slides. Full Auto, prefer editable PPTX and keep sources. Explain alternatives when tools are missing.

Actual authoring environment

ScopeVerifiedUnverified
AuthoringThis Codex session directly read local skill guidance and produced filesLoading, automatic selection and invocation in other hosts
Native PPTXpython-pptx export/re-import; LibreOffice renderingPowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides and recipient fonts
CLIInstallation commands documentedNo end-to-end install/update in a temporary host in this task

If your agent does not use the skill

  1. Check whether the host recognizes the installation directory.
  2. Reload or start a new session as required.
  3. Invoke $subaru-slides / $subaru-brainstorm explicitly; otherwise request the named skill in plain language.
  4. When reporting a failure, include the host, command and error. Exclude credentials.

Updates and versions

npx skills update subaru-brainstorm -p

Update from the original project; use -g for global installations. Back up local customizations first. Package versions come from SKILL.md metadata.version; main is development content, not a stable release. Full update and fixed-tag instructions.

title: 怎样制作可编辑中文 PPT？
description: 区分原生可编辑对象与整页图片；提供调用提示、原生表格图表案例和中文字体边界。
body:
指定“文字、表格、图表与流程图保持原生可编辑”，并让 Agent 先检查是否有原生构建能力。

明确你要编辑什么

内容原生 PPTX整页图片型 PPTX
文字可选中修改图片中的字通常不能直接修改
图表与表格可修改对象；图表需保留数据只能替换或裁切图片
照片与插图可以是位图，说明边界与其他内容合在一张图中

可以直接使用的要求

用 $subaru-slides 将以下材料做成 6 页中文管理层汇报。优先原生可编辑 PPTX；文字、表格、图表与流程图用原生对象。仅使用提供的数据，保留来源和备注；没有原生构建器时先说明。

检查实际产物

下载管理层汇报案例，检查图表、表格、流程图和备注。结构检查证明对象存在；仍需在目标应用中检查编辑操作。

中文字体边界

本例使用 PingFang SC，字体未嵌入。本机 LibreOffice 渲染通过不代表收件人的设备有同样字体。换成已授权、可用的字体后重新渲染；不要把字体声明当作字体已经加载。

title: How do I make an editable Chinese PPT?
description: Distinguish native editable objects from slide images, with a prompt, native examples and Chinese font limits.
body:
Ask for native editable text, tables, charts and diagrams, and have the agent check for a native builder first.

Specify what must be editable

ContentNative PPTXFull-slide image PPTX
TextSelect and edit textText within the image is usually not directly editable
Charts and tablesEdit native objects; charts must retain dataReplace or crop the image
Photos and illustrationsMay remain raster; disclose the boundaryCombined with the rest of the slide

A prompt to reuse

Use $subaru-slides for six Chinese executive slides from the following material. Prefer native editable PPTX. Use native text, tables, charts and diagrams. Use only supplied data; keep sources and notes. Explain if a native builder is unavailable.

Inspect the actual result

Download the management example and inspect its chart, table, diagram and notes. Structural checks establish object presence; editing still needs verification in the target application.

Chinese font limits

The example uses PingFang SC without font embedding. Local LibreOffice rendering does not establish font availability on a recipient's machine. Substitute a licensed available font and render again. A font declaration is not proof that it loaded.

title: 没有生图工具还能做演示文稿吗？
description: 没有生图能力时使用原生文字、图表、表格与流程图；解释 HTML 与图片型 PPTX 的边界。
body:
可以。生图是可选增强；有原生构建器时，可以使用原生文字、图表、表格与流程图完成演示文稿。

先确认可用能力

让 Agent 按 skill 指引探测构建、渲染与字体能力。缺少生图时，省略场景插图并重排页面；不能把“省略插图”说成已经生成了插图。

用 $subaru-slides 做 6 页技术分享。不用 AI 配图，架构图与流程图用原生对象。说明当前能导出的格式，以及没有完成的检查。

本次实际案例

RAG 技术分享完全没有使用生成图片。技术关系由原生矩形、文字和连接线表达。

如果原生构建器也缺失

Agent 应说明是否能提供 HTML deck，或只有图片型 PPTX 兜底。HTML 文件可编辑不等于已经导出 PPTX；图片装配也不会恢复原生文字。具体路径规则以 SKILL.md 为准。

title: Can I make slides without image generation?
description: Use native text, charts, tables and diagrams without image generation; understand HTML and image-only limits.
body:
Yes. Image generation is optional. With a native builder, text, charts, tables and diagrams can form the presentation.

Check available capabilities first

Have the agent probe construction, rendering and fonts using the skill guidance. Without image generation, omit scene illustrations and rearrange the page. Omission must not be reported as successful generation.

Use $subaru-slides for six technical slides. Do not use AI images. Make architecture and flow diagrams native objects. State available exports and checks not performed.

An actual example

The RAG presentation uses no generated images. Native rectangles, text and connectors explain the relationships.

If there is no native builder either

The agent should explain whether HTML or an image-only PPTX is available. Editable HTML does not establish PPTX export; image assembly does not recover native text. The runtime source of truth is SKILL.md.

title: AI 点子总是相似，怎样换入口？
description: 使用 subaru-brainstorm 拆假设、改变机制、保留分支，查看八个方向到实验卡的原创示例。
body:
指出已有想法共同依赖的条件，再要求换一个思考动作。增加数量本身不证明方向变得不同。

从具体重复开始

用 $subaru-brainstorm 继续。现有方案都依赖成员主动上传资料；拆开这个假设，再给 8 个不同机制的方向。先不评价，也不要只是换名字。

保留能继续的方向

引用想法编号，例如“沿 I07 展开一次具体交互，I02 暂存”。归类不会自动成为排名；需要比较时再说清目标和条件。

从方向到小实验

知识库用途案例保存八个想法、一个助手选择的演示分支、三人实验卡与续谈摘要。没有补造用户选择或实验结果。

效果边界

这是思考与协作方法，不承诺创造力提升。示例只是一次实际编写的产物，不是独立评审或配对模型效果证据。

title: How do I move beyond repetitive AI ideas?
description: Use subaru-brainstorm to question assumptions, vary mechanisms and retain branches; inspect a worked experiment example.
body:
Name the shared dependency behind existing ideas, then request a different thinking action. More ideas alone do not establish greater variety.

Identify the repetition

Continue with $subaru-brainstorm. These ideas all require members to upload material voluntarily. Question that assumption and give eight different mechanisms, without ranking or merely renaming them.

Retain branches you can revisit

Refer to stable identifiers: “Expand one interaction for I07; keep I02 for later.” Grouping does not automatically rank ideas. Request comparison with explicit goals and conditions when needed.

From direction to a small experiment

The knowledge-library example retains eight ideas, a branch selected by the assistant for demonstration, a three-person experiment card and a resume snapshot. No user choices or observations were invented.

Evidence limits

This is a thinking and collaboration method, not a promise of increased creativity. The saved example is one authored result, not independent review or paired-model evidence.

title: 怎样保存讨论并接着展开？
description: 保留目标、限制、稳定编号、评价约定与未决事项，通过可携带摘要跨会话续谈。
body:
让 Agent 导出续谈摘要。下一次提供该摘要，并说明从哪个分支继续；不用依赖宿主拥有永久记忆。

暂停时

用 $subaru-brainstorm 保存当前讨论摘要：目标、限制、先别评价的约定、稳定编号、当前分支、其他保留路线和未知。不要补造我没有作出的选择。

恢复时

根据下面摘要继续。目标不变，先展开 B01 没有人接续的情况。保留其他路线，暂时不排名。

检查摘要

检查编号是否保持原指向、助手建议是否被误写成用户决定、实验设计是否被误写成观察。缺失信息应保持未知。

有文件工具时可以保存到自己的项目目录；没有时复制文本。查看实际快照文件。

title: How do I save and resume a discussion?
description: Carry goals, constraints, stable identifiers, evaluation agreement and unknowns into the next session.
body:
Export a resume summary. Provide it in the next session and name the branch to continue. Permanent host memory is not required.

When pausing

Use $subaru-brainstorm to save the goal, constraints, deferred evaluation agreement, stable identifiers, active branch, retained routes and unknowns. Do not invent choices I have not made.

When resuming

Continue from this summary. Keep the goal and other routes. First expand what happens when nobody continues B01; do not rank ideas yet.

Check the summary

Check that identifiers retain their meaning, assistant suggestions are not recorded as user choices, and experiment plans are not recorded as observations. Missing information stays unknown.

Save in your own project when file tools exist; otherwise copy the text. Inspect an actual snapshot.

title: 许可与发布状态
description: 原创内容与第三方来源的许可边界、当前开发版本、稳定发布所需证据。
body:
原创案例和 subaru-brainstorm 适用仓库 MIT。subaru-slides 含第三方来源内容，其再分发授权仍待确认。

许可按内容区分

根 MIT LICENSE覆盖仓库原创内容，不能替第三方复制内容授予许可。PROVENANCE.md记录 slides 上游审计基线没有根 LICENSE，以及风格样例图的许可边界。

本站的新案例、代码和预览均为原创；没有打包第三方 PDF、截图、logo 或字体。它们的公开展示不代表 slides 包已解决授权问题。

当前发布状态

2026-10-07 只读核查远端 tag 列表为空；本次没有创建 Release 或稳定 tag。当前包版本带开发预发布标记。发布状态以后以 GitHub Releases 的实际记录为准。

稳定发布前

  • slides 第三方内容取得授权，或由维护者确认后替换、移除并检查引用。
  • 完成目标宿主安装、加载与更新的端到端验证。
  • 记录版本、发布范围、测试结果与未验证能力。
  • 经授权创建不可变 tag 和 Release，再提供固定 tag 命令。

单次案例和结构检查不等于通用质量证明。Brainstorm 的配对模型证据与跨机 PPTX 兼容性仍未完成。

title: License and release status
description: License boundaries for original and third-party content, development versions and stable-release readiness.
body:
Original cases and subaru-brainstorm use the repository MIT license. Redistribution permission for third-party content in subaru-slides remains unresolved.

Content-specific licensing

The root MIT LICENSE covers original content; it cannot grant rights to copied third-party content. PROVENANCE.md records the missing upstream root license at the slides audit baseline and sample-image boundaries.

New cases, code and previews on this site are original. No third-party PDF, screenshot, logo or font is bundled. Publishing these cases does not resolve the slides package's authorization gap.

Release status

A read-only remote tag check on 2026-10-07 returned no tags. This task created no Release or stable tag. Package versions carry development suffixes. Future status should be checked against actual GitHub Releases.

Before a stable release

  • Obtain slides redistribution permission, or have maintainers confirm replacement/removal and check references.
  • Verify end-to-end installation, loading and updating in target hosts.
  • Record versions, release scope, checks and unverified capabilities.
  • Create an immutable tag and Release with authorization, then document the fixed-tag command.

Single examples and structure checks do not prove general quality. Paired brainstorm evidence and cross-machine PPTX compatibility remain incomplete.
